name: Round-Trip Record
text: If you pass or swap four or more cards in a round, gain +1× contract multiplier.

signature.trigger: scoring, four or more cards passed or swapped

archetypes: Swap Meet; splash Kingmaker, Nil Guard
decision: Whether each optional pass or swap is worth making for the count, even when it breaks a hand you liked.
opponent: Each pass and swap is shown, so opponents can count toward four.
aiNote: Take every optional pass or swap until you reach four cards.
rationale: A Swap Meet deck with Traders' Handshake or Barter Bridge plus one before- or after-bidding pass moves four cards in about half its rounds, so +1× is worth about +45 mid and +60 late; without pass tools it never fires. It applies win or lose.
deviation: Redesigned from passing the same card twice, which was hard to read and hard to trigger.
